# Introduction

Extract the homework ZIP and keep the `data/` folder next to your `.qmd` file. Use [`data/ElephantsMF.csv`](../data/ElephantsMF.csv) for the tasks below.

The dataset contains the following columns:

\- `rownames`: Unique identifiers for each record (elephant).\
- `Age`: Age of the elephants (years).\
- `Height`: Height of the elephants (cm).\
- `Sex`: Sex of the elephants (`M` for Male, `F` for Female).

#### Instructions

Open this Quarto document (`.qmd`) in RStudio. Add your R code to the code chunks and click **Render** to run the code and create an HTML report with your results.

> **Every result must be shown! If you create or changing some variable/column/dataframe, show it!**

> Don't forget to save your changes where needed

For example, `dataset |> function()` does not change the `dataset`, but `dataset <- dataset |> function()` does
